name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that reads what real people are actually saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, and prediction markets on any topic, then writes you a grounded summary instead of generic AI guesses.
buyer: A content creator or small marketing team that needs fresh, credible talking points on a trending topic but doesn't have an in-house research team.
business_use_cases: A newsletter writer runs it every morning on their niche topic to find real discussion threads worth covering, instead of guessing what's trending.
A brand's social media manager checks genuine audience sentiment on a topic before posting, avoiding tone-deaf content.
An investment researcher cross-references prediction-market odds with social chatter to sanity-check a thesis before writing it up.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'daily trend briefing' newsletter for a specific niche, generated with this skill plus human editing.
Sell one-off custom research reports to marketing agencies on demand.

steal_this: Pick one niche (e.g. 'AI coding tools'), run this daily, and publish a free public digest to build an audience you can later monetize with sponsorships.
